'''Leonid Mikhailovich Shkadov''' (1927–2003) was a Russian [[scientist]], engineer in [[aircraft]] development and optimisation, one of the [[TsAGI]] deputy directors (1986-2003), a [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Engineering]], [[professor]], and recipient of the [[USSR State Prize]] (1977).<ref name="XXvek2005">{{cite book |editor-last=Остапенко |editor-first=Юрий|date=2005 |title=XX век. Авиастроение России в лицах |trans-title=XXth Century. Faces of Russian Aviation Industry |language=RU |location=Москва |publisher=МОО «Общество авиастроителей» |pages=552 }}</ref><ref name="PGZh">{{cite web |url=http://zhukovskiy.ru/шкадов-леонид-михайлович/ |title=Шкадов Леонид Михайлович |author=<!--Not stated--> |language=RU |publisher=Администрация городского округа Жуковский |accessdate=2018-03-17 }}</ref><ref name="TsAGI1993">{{cite book |last1=Бюшгенс |first1=Г. С. |last2=Бедржицкий |first2=Е. Л. |date=1993 |title=ЦАГИ - центр авиационной науки |trans-title=TsAGI - The center of aeronautical science |url=https://search.rsl.ru/ru/search#q=%D0%A6%D0%90%D0%93%D0%98-%D1%86%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D1%80%20%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B9%20%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B8%20%3A%20%5B%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%B7%D0%BE%D1%80%20%D0%B4%D0%B5%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%20%D0%B8%D0%BD-%D1%82%D0%B0%20%D0%B7%D0%B0%2075%20%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%5D |language=RU |location=[[Moscow|Москва]] |publisher=[[Nauka (publisher)|Наука]] |pages=272 }}</ref>

Shkadov came up with the idea of the [[Stellar engine|Shkadov Thruster]].<ref>{{cite conference |bibcode=1987brig.iafcR....S |title=Possibility of controlling solar system motion in the Galaxy |last=Shkadov |first=Leonid |date=10–17 October 1987 |publisher=International Astronautical Federation |book-title=Proceedings of the IAF 38th International Astronautical Congress |pages=1–8 |location=Brighton, England |conference=38th International Astronautical Congress IAC 1987 }}</ref>

== Awards and decorations ==
* [[USSR State Prize]] (1977)
* [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour]] (1971) 
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (1966) 
* [[Order of Friendship]] (1998) 
* [[Jubilee Medal "In Commemoration of the 100th Anniversary of the Birth of Vladimir Ilyich Lenin"]], [[Medal "Veteran of Labour"]] and [[Jubilee Medal "300 Years of the Russian Navy"]] (1997)
* [[Honoured Scientist of the RSFSR]] (1988)
* [[Ministerial awards of the Russian Federation|Honoured Aircraft Engineer of the USSR]] (1987)
* [[Zhukovsky, Moscow Oblast|Zhukovsky]] [[Honorary citizenship|Honorary Citizen]]
